function: Statistical precoder design for sum-rate maximization: a GNN takes only channel statistics, also the approximate statistics from GMM-based limited feedback in FDD (pp. 2-3).
system: Single-cell downlink, BS with N=64 antennas (ULA in simulation, 4x16 URA in measurements), J single-antenna users, FDD, measured band 2.18 GHz, no RIS (pp. 1-2, 4).
method: Edge-GAT graph neural network (feature extractor plus attention layers) trained with negative sum-rate loss (unsupervised); GMM fitted offline by EM for the feedback (pp. 2-4).
data_channel: Spatial channel model of [12] (conditionally Gaussian, ULA N=64) and Nokia campus Stuttgart measurements (urban microcell, 2.18 GHz, URA 4x16); 2,400 training scenarios of 16 users (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained with J=16 users and SNR 0-20 dB; tested with 2-24 users, SNR sweep, B=6 bits, 8 or 16 pilots; measured data in separate sets (pp. 3-5).
baselines: Non-learned: SWMMSE (genie statistics or GMM feedback) and IWMMSE with DFT-codebook feedback (LS or GMM channel estimate); no earlier learned precoder compared (pp. 4-5).
metrics: Average sum-rate in bps/Hz versus number of users and versus SNR; orders of complexity in Table I (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Table I: orders of complexity, GNN precoder O(sum_l M_l M_{l-1}), GMM feedback O(K n_p^2); SWMMSE O(I_max I_b N^3), IWMMSE O(I_max N^3) (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "we use the same dataset sizes for training and validating the GNN, for training the GMM, and for testing" on measurement data from the Nokia campus in Stuttgart (p. 2, Fig. 4).
q2_support: p. 4: "the GNNs are solely trained for this configuration (J = 16 MTs) and effectively generalize to configurations with fewer or more served MTs".
q3_support: p. 1: baselines are "stochastic iterative algorithms and discrete Fourier transform" codebook approaches; p. 4: "Another baseline is the DFT codebook-based limited feedback scheme". All non-learned; no earlier learned precoder (e.g. the GNNs of [5], [9]) is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "Table I presents a complexity analysis of the different methods"; Table I gives O(sum of M_l M_{l-1}) for the GNN precoder design and O(K n_p^2) for the GMM feedback inference.
q5_support: p. 4: "we use the same dataset sizes for training and validating the GNN, for training the GMM, and for testing" on measured data (p. 2: Nokia campus in Stuttgart); no code or data link is given.
notes: Include, area 3 (precoder design, main metric sum-rate; the GMM feedback comes from the authors' earlier work [10] and is shared with the baseline SWMMSE+GMM). q3=0: baselines are SWMMSE and IWMMSE with DFT codebook, all non-learned, and the GNN precoders of [5], [9] are not compared. q1 and q5 rest only on the measured data (no 3GPP model, no released code or data), so the reviewer should confirm that measured data alone is enough.
